entities.summary: Riva Ganguly Das is a retired Indian civil servant who belongs to the Indian Foreign Service cadre. She is the former High Commissioner of India to Bangladesh and former director general of the Indian Council for Cultural Relations, an autonomous organisation of the Government of India.
